scope: Isolated Edge with a test-only all-host grant, synthetic credentials, local HTML/image fixtures and simulated AI. No live AI accuracy claim.

results.name: Generic capture includes semantic sibling figures and image tables but excludes hidden, navigation and unrelated panels
Popup viewport action captures a CSS table with no DOM table semantics; preview remains local and unselected
Viewport capture refuses a page that scrolls during capture and creates no misleading companion
PNG screenshot import retains provenance, does not select/send it, and detects duplicate content
JPEG and WebP imports decode locally and normalize to bounded JPEG previews
Clipboard accepts an image while ordinary text paste stays available
Unsupported, oversized and corrupt files are rejected without adding cards or network calls
Explicit image-table analysis sends pixels and row/column transcription rules and renders Markdown tables safely
Import is unavailable during AI analysis and paste cannot change the active request
Streaming renderer coalesces rapid fragments and immediately flushes final text without duplicate DOM replacement
Stopping flushes received text and clearing a view prevents a queued render from reviving old content
Rapid burst output preserves all content while batching visible DOM updates
Rapid codeburst output preserves all content while batching visible DOM updates
Viewport preview preserves all 100 source candidates and reports candidates beyond the storage limit
Remote figure metadata lookup avoids decoding stored images and still rejects expired captures
Document reader shares screenshot import and discards an in-flight import when a new document replaces the source
Screenshot controls and table previews fit a narrow companion
